_note: Verdicts from watching the video, which the text gate cannot do. 'keep' bypasses the text gate and the author blocklist; 'reject' is permanent. Frames sampled at >=1 fps - a play is 3-5s and a catch under 1s, so one thumbnail is not enough. 'keep_preseason_only' does show the named player, but the footage is from a previous season; it counts only while no games have been played. 'games' records the scoreboard read off a clip as "AWAY@HOME AS-HS"; scoreboard.py resolves it to a season and week against nflverse, so in season only the current week's games pass.
